title: Fixed Stairs Recipe
description: As pointed out by a random youtube short I happened upon... the stairs recipe doesn't make sense... So I fixed it.
body:
Credit to GarrettTheCarrot for pointing out that the recipe for stairs didn't make sense. He made a good point on what the recipe should actually look like to me. So I did it. Cause I know how to make datapacks and can absoulutely do that. I have changed every recipe for crafting stairs at a crafting table to match now.

I've included as seperate version datapacks that do the same thing for various mods I personally play with! I'll list what things I already have a pack for. **Don't install a pack you don't have the mod for each one is labeled**
- Vanilla
- No Block Left Behind
- Biomes Of Plenty
- Stoneworks

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d7a9e98051061a67865075c4589388229421b1d3_0.webp)

[GarretTheCarrot's Short](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0ZI5RoCjE9I)
